title: Aft Cargo Door Actuation — Operational Test
abstract: Operational test of the aft cargo door actuation, measuring the opening and closing times against the ambient temperature curve and checking the door bay for hydraulic leakage after the cycle.

sections.purpose: This task gives the operational test of the aft cargo door actuation. Use it after any work on the actuator, the supply lines or the isolation valve, and as the closing test of the door bay leak investigation.
sections.job_setup_note: The test needs the hydraulic system pressurised from the ground cart or from the electric pump, and the ambient temperature recorded at the start and at the end. Clear the door swing area and station one person at the door control panel and one at the door bay with a torch. Do not do the test with a loaded container against the door.
sections.procedure: WARNING: KEEP ALL PERSONNEL OUT OF THE DOOR SWING AREA DURING THE TEST. THE DOOR MOVES WITHOUT WARNING WHEN THE CONTROL PANEL IS OPERATED. Record the ambient temperature and put the aircraft on ground power. Pressurise the hydraulic system to normal operating pressure and let it stabilise for five minutes. Clean and dry the door bay so that any new leakage can be seen. Operate the door to the fully open position and record the time from the first movement to the fully open indication. Hold the door open for ten minutes and inspect the door bay for fluid. Operate the door to the fully closed and latched position and record the time. CAUTION: STOP THE TEST IF THE DOOR STOPS BEFORE THE FULLY OPEN OR FULLY CLOSED INDICATION. DO NOT REPEAT THE CYCLE, BECAUSE A REPEATED STALL WILL OVERHEAT THE ACTUATOR. Repeat the open and close cycle twice more and record all six times. Compare the mean time against the ambient temperature curve in the illustration and confirm that it is inside the band. Inspect the door bay again and record any fluid found, with its position relative to the actuator. Depressurise the hydraulic system.
sections.close_out: Remove the ground power and the hydraulic supply. Record the six measured times, the ambient temperature and the door bay condition. Where a time falls outside the band or fluid is found, raise a report and refer to the applicable fault isolation procedure before the aircraft is released.

type_data.effectivity_note: Aircraft with hydraulic cargo door actuation. The temperature curve of the second illustration applies below zero degrees.

safety_precautions: Clear the door swing area and keep it clear for the whole test.
Do not do the test with a loaded container against the door.
Record the ambient temperature at the start and at the end.
